engineeringSkip.reason: This is a buzzword mash-up of quantum computing and biomanufacturing, describing no actual machine or research programme — quantum simulators cannot synthesize molecules, and no such technology exists or is theorised.

factCheck.reason: "Quantum synthesis" is not a real technology — it is a vague mash-up of quantum computing and synthetic biology, with no described machine, mechanism or research programme behind it; quantum computers doing chemistry calculations and biomanufacturing are separate real fields, but nothing called a quantum synthesis machine exists or has a defined way to be built.
